news.title: Speed networking pairs alumni, students
news.summary_en: Notre Dame held its first Executive Connections, a speed networking event that brought 24 alumni executives to campus to meet MBA and Specialized Master’s students.

news.title: Bestselling author Martha MacCallum to discuss ‘The Book of Valor’
